approaches.approach: Approximation compactness and escape in affine-line space
approaches.proved: Separated-parameter persistence and a finite-line-family escape criterion
approaches.obstruction: No uniform noncollapse or escape from a finite line family for arbitrary wild limits; topological stability of approximants is not supplied.

approaches.proved: Explicit shear straightening for coordinate graphs; finite-contact reduction to quadrisecant-free local arcs
approaches.obstruction: Quadrisecant-free arcs are not proved locally flat; infinitely many contacts on finitely many lines remain uncontrolled.

approaches.approach: Local tangles and stable four-arc transversals
approaches.proved: Nondegenerate 8-variable local transversal construction; line-family localization criterion; closure yields at best three genuine points
approaches.obstruction: Arbitrary wildness does not supply the four-arc pattern or eliminate artificial closure intersections; region separation does not imply line separation.

approaches.approach: Topology of the trisecant configuration space
approaches.proved: Compact unique-middle-point locus is homeomorphic to its endpoint projection away from collisions
approaches.obstruction: No manifold/cycle structure or collision-boundary control; disk construction does not establish a wild boundary collar.

approaches.proved: Rectifiable tame unknot of infinite total curvature with no trisecants
approaches.obstruction: Geometric turning alone cannot force quadrisecants; a topologically sensitive line-count lower bound is missing.
